messages:
From: Raina Gupta <raina@aureliahealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 13:10:00 -0400
Subject: Initial ask — adoption template and acceptance gates

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the intro last week. We're ready to formalize the evaluation cadence at Aurelia and would like a lightweight mutual action plan (we call it an adoption stencil) that ties technical validation to procurement milestones. The timeline is tight — procurement wants a pilot decision in ~30 days.

Can you share a starter doc (GDoc or slides) that outlines:
- key success criteria (technical + business),
- tech validation checkpoints (data, latency, PII handling),
- who owns tasks on both sides,
- suggested demo & decision dates.

Also, any sample acceptance language we can pass to procurement would help accelerate approvals.

Raina
Director of Platform Engineering
Aurelia Health

P.S. Our evaluation lead is Ethan Morales (cc'd).

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Raina Gupta <raina@aureliahealth.com>, Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:24:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initial ask — adoption template and acceptance gates

Hi Raina / Ethan —

Great to kick this off. Attached is a compact "joint adoption stencil" (GDoc) plus a 6-slide starter deck to use with stakeholders. Highlights below and next steps.

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood-joint-adopt-stencil.gdoc (Google Doc — template with lanes for owners, acceptance gates, and test cases)
- starter-deck-v1.pptx (6 slides: overview, acceptance criteria, timeline, tech checkpoints, owners, risk log)

Quick summary of the recommended cadence:
1) Week 0 (today–7 days): Align stakeholders, finalize acceptance gates, provide test data access.
2) Week 1–2: Technical run (latency, correctness on a canonical prompt set); weekly sync.
3) Week 3: Pilot demo + procurement review.
4) Decision at day 30 (go/no-go, procurement sign-off).

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood: Kar thik (eng lead), Marissa (CS ops), Jasmine (solutions / eval scenarios)
- Aurelia: Raina (platform), Ethan (technical lead), procurement (legal/proc contact)

Suggested acceptance examples (copy/paste friendly):
- "Model meets 95th percentile latency <= 250ms for target load with sample dataset X."
- "Key intent classification F1 >= 0.85 on evaluation set Y."
- "No high or critical data leakage findings in the security scan; audit log delivery to Aurelia KMS confirmed."

Next steps I recommend: review the attached stencil, mark ownership columns, and we'll co-edit the live doc this week. Marissa — can you own the procurement-facing acceptance wording and convert to the legal-ready bullet so Raina can share with their procurement team? Jasmine — can you draft two sample tech validation tests for Week 1?

Happy to jump on a 30-min sync today if helpful.

—Kar thik
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
